name: no-comments
purpose: Spawn Comment Sicko, fix accepted findings, and offer encodings for claimed constraints.
triggers: Explicit no-comments invocation; disable-model-invocation metadata is retained without assuming host enforcement.
inputs: Caller-scoped files or diff, otherwise current diff against the base branch, default main, including working tree.
Authorization for scoped comment deletions and accepted fixes; separate approval for constraint encodings.
outputs: Scoped comment deletions and accepted root-cause fixes when authorized.
Report deletion count, restored comments, reruns, architect sketch, fixes, encoding offers, encodings, unenforced constraints and other open work.
ordinaryExample: Invoke no-comments on an authorized diff to remove redundant narration while retaining its license header and justified public API contract.
capabilityLimits: Missing independent workers allows authorized sequential review as reduced capability, including authorized scoped edits.
Unavailable or unauthorized writes allows an authorized read-only proposal report with actual deletion count zero; required edits otherwise block.
Required investigation needs scoped code, rules and how or why; unavailable evidence remains a skip.
Unattended/eval encoding requires caller pre-approval. Host behavior has not been tested.
